tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad=2.44, above the 2.36 gray-zone gate. A high_sgrad_regime_probe is explicitly indicated before fitting; it can distinguish the smooth siphon from the threshold-avalanche extension.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth three-parameter siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad=2.44 enters the stated unverified supercritical gray zone, where a threshold-avalanche term may change the law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter threshold-avalanche siphon now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Without a high-s_grad regime measurement, threshold location and avalanche strength are not adequately identified.
The targeted high_sgrad_regime_probe directly tests the suspected threshold regime at lower cost.
It is not relevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
